title: RMT: Retentive Networks Meet Vision Transformers
venue: 2024 IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR)

problem.summary: Vision Transformer (ViT) has gained increasing attention in the computer vision community in recent years.
statements: Vision Transformer (ViT) has gained increasing attention in the computer vision community in recent years.
However, the core component of ViT, Self-Attention, lacks explicit spatial priors and bears a quadratic computational complexity, thereby constraining the applicability of ViT.

To alleviate these issues, we draw inspiration from the recent Retentive Network (RetNet) in the field of NLP, and propose RMT, a strong vision backbone with explicit spatial prior for general purposes.
